checks.text: On load, the page shows the heading "Sudoku Puzzle", the select "Difficulty" with "Easy" selected, the button "New Game", and the timer "Time" reading "00:00".
Selecting "Practice" and clicking "New Game" shows "1" in "Row 1, Column 1", an empty "Row 1, Column 2", and the timer "00:00".
In a Practice game, clicking "Row 1, Column 1" then the button "5" leaves its text "1".
In a Practice game, clicking "Row 1, Column 2" then the button "2" makes its text "2".
In a Practice game with the clock paused, after `fastForward(1000)` the timer reads "00:01", and after another `fastForward(2000)` it reads "00:03".
Selecting "Hard" and clicking "New Game" gives at least 30 gridcells with empty text.

In a Practice game with the clock paused, entering 2 in Row 1 Column 2, 8 in Row 2 Column 5, 9 in Row 5 Column 5 and 8 in Row 9 Column 9 shows "Puzzle Solved"; the timer text then stays the same after `fastForward(5000)`.
In a Practice game, entering 1 in "Row 1, Column 2" gives that cell `aria-invalid="true"` and shows the text "Invalid move".
Reload keeps the board: in a Practice game, after entering 2 in "Row 1, Column 2" and reloading, that cell reads "2" and "Row 2, Column 5" is still empty.
